    <h2>{`About this task`}</h2>
    <p>{`In Graphite applications, there are several ways to mark fields as required to ensure data integrity and guide users to provide necessary information. This guide explains the different methods available for marking fields as required and provides examples for each approach, organized by common scenarios.`}</p>
    <h2>{`Scenarios`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Marking fields required at the Datasource level`}</h3>
    <p>{`One of the most fundamental ways to mark a field as required in a Graphite application is through the datasource attribute’s required property. When an attribute in the datasource is marked as required, any UI field bound to that attribute will automatically be treated as required.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Datasource Configuration:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<datasource id="workOrderDS">
  <attribute name="description" required="true" />
  <attribute name="location" required="true" />
  <attribute name="priority" />
</datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`UI Field Binding:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<text-input id="descriptionField" label="Description" value="{datasource.description}" />
<text-input id="locationField" label="Location" value="{datasource.location}" />
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`What happens:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Fields bound to required attributes will automatically be treated as required`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`An asterisk appears next to the field label`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Form submission is prevented if the field is empty`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Validation is handled at the datasource level`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When to use:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`When the requirement is driven by the data model`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`For consistent enforcement of required fields across multiple pages`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`When the field should always be required regardless of UI context`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`Basic Required Fields`}</h3>
    <p>{`The simplest scenario is marking fields as permanently required using the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`required`}</inlineCode>{` attribute in your XML.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`XML Configuration:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<text-input id="description" label="Description" required="true" />
<number-input id="quantity" label="Quantity" required="true" />
<dropdown id="status" label="Status" required="true">
  <dropdown-item value="active" label="Active" />
  <dropdown-item value="inactive" label="Inactive" />
</dropdown>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`What happens:`}</strong></p>

 * @param {string} fieldId - The field ID
 * @param {Object} context - Validation context
 * @returns {string} - The error message
 */
getErrorMessage(fieldId, context) {
  switch (fieldId) {
    case 'workOrderId':
      return 'Work Order ID is required and must be in the format WO-XXXXX';
    case 'priority':
      return context.isEmergency

    default:
      return 'This field is required';
  }

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When to use:`}</strong></p>

    <h3>{`Conditionally Required Fields`}</h3>

 * Handle emergency checkbox change
 * @param {boolean} checked - Whether emergency is checked
 */
handleEmergencyChange(checked) {
  this.page.state.workOrder.emergency = checked;
  
  // Update required fields based on emergency status
  this.updateRequiredFields();
  
  // If emergency is checked, priority must be high
  if (checked && this.page.state.workOrder.priority !== '1') {
    this.page.state.workOrder.priority = '1';
  }
}

/**
 * Update which fields are required based on current state
 */
updateRequiredFields() {
  const workOrder = this.page.state.workOrder;
  const requiredFields = {
    description: true,  // Always required
    location: true,     // Always required
    priority: workOrder.emergency,  // Required if emergency
    notes: workOrder.emergency      // Required if emergency
  };
  
  this.page.state.requiredFields = requiredFields;
}

    <h3>{`Complex Validation Rules`}</h3>
    <p>{`For scenarios requiring more sophisticated validation beyond simple “required” checks.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`JavaScript Implementation:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Validate a specific field
 * @param {string} fieldId - The field to validate
 * @returns {boolean} - Whether the field is valid
 */
validateField(fieldId) {
  const workOrder = this.page.state.workOrder;
  const requiredFields = this.page.state.requiredFields;
  const errors = this.page.state.validationErrors || {};
  
  // Clear previous error
  delete errors[fieldId];
  
  // Check if field is required and validate accordingly
  switch (fieldId) {
    case 'description':
      if (requiredFields.description && (!workOrder.description || workOrder.description.trim() === '')) {
        errors[fieldId] = 'Description is required';
        return false;
      }
      break;
      
    case 'assetId':
      if (requiredFields.assetId) {
        if (!workOrder.assetId) {
          errors[fieldId] = 'Asset ID is required';
          return false;
        }
        // Check format (e.g., ASSET-12345)
        if (!/^ASSET-\\d{5}$/.test(workOrder.assetId)) {
          errors[fieldId] = 'Asset ID must be in format ASSET-XXXXX';
          return false;
        }
      }
      break;
      
    case 'estimatedCost':
      if (requiredFields.estimatedCost) {
        if (workOrder.estimatedCost === undefined || workOrder.estimatedCost === null) {
          errors[fieldId] = 'Estimated cost is required';
          return false;
        }
        // Must be a positive number
        if (isNaN(workOrder.estimatedCost) || workOrder.estimatedCost <= 0) {
          errors[fieldId] = 'Estimated cost must be greater than zero';
          return false;
        }
      }
      break;
  }
  
  // Update validation errors
  this.page.state.validationErrors = errors;
  return true;
}
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When to use:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>

    <h3>{`Form-Level Validation`}</h3>
    <p>{`For validating multiple fields together or implementing cross-field validation.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`JavaScript Implementation:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Validate the entire form
 * @returns {boolean} - Whether the form is valid
 */
validateForm() {
  const workOrder = this.page.state.workOrder;
  const errors = {};
  let isValid = true;
  
  // Individual field validation
  if (!workOrder.description || workOrder.description.trim() === '') {
    errors.description = 'Description is required';
    isValid = false;
  }
  
  if (!workOrder.location || workOrder.location.trim() === '') {
    errors.location = 'Location is required';
    isValid = false;
  }
  
  // Cross-field validation
  if (workOrder.startDate && workOrder.endDate) {
    if (new Date(workOrder.startDate) > new Date(workOrder.endDate)) {
      errors.endDate = 'End date must be after start date';
      isValid = false;
    }
  }
  
  // Conditional validation
  if (workOrder.type === 'preventive' && !workOrder.frequency) {
    errors.frequency = 'Frequency is required for preventive work orders';
    isValid = false;
  }
  
  // Update validation errors
  this.page.state.validationErrors = errors;
  return isValid;
}

/**
 * Handle form submission
 */
handleSubmit() {
  if (this.validateForm()) {
    // Form is valid, proceed with submission
    this.saveWorkOrder(this.page.state.workOrder);
  } else {
    // Show error message
    this.app.toast('Please correct the errors in the form', 'error');
  }
}
`}</code></pre>

  <state name="validationErrors" type="object" default-value="{}" />
  <state name="requiredFields" type="object" default-value="{description: true, location: true}" />
  
  <page-header>
    <page-title>Create Work Order</page-title>
  </page-header>
  
  <container>

      <text-input 
        id="description"

      />
      
      <text-input 
        id="location"

      />
      
      <checkbox

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`AppCustomizations.js:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`import {Application} from '@maximo/maximo-js-api';

class AppCustomizations {
  /**
   * Initialize page references when the page is initialized
   * @param {Object} page - The page object
   * @param {Object} app - The application object
   */
  async pageInitialized(page, app) {
    this.page = page;
    this.app = app;
    
    if (page && page.name === 'workOrderForm') {
      // Initialize form state
      this.updateRequiredFields();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Handle description change
   * @param {string} value - The new description value
   */
  handleDescriptionChange(value) {
    this.page.state.workOrder.description = value;
    this.validateField('description');
  }

  /**
   * Handle location change
   * @param {string} value - The new location value
   */
  handleLocationChange(value) {
    this.page.state.workOrder.location = value;
    this.validateField('location');
  }

  /**
   * Handle priority change
   * @param {string} value - The new priority value
   */
  handlePriorityChange(value) {
    this.page.state.workOrder.priority = value;
    this.validateField('priority');
  }

  /**
   * Handle emergency checkbox change
   * @param {boolean} checked - Whether emergency is checked
   */
  handleEmergencyChange(checked) {
    this.page.state.workOrder.emergency = checked;
    
    // Update required fields based on emergency status
    this.updateRequiredFields();
    
    // If emergency is checked, priority must be high
    if (checked && this.page.state.workOrder.priority !== '1') {
      this.page.state.workOrder.priority = '1';
    }
    
    // Validate notes field which is now required
    this.validateField('notes');
  }

  /**
   * Handle notes change
   * @param {string} value - The new notes value
   */
  handleNotesChange(value) {
    this.page.state.workOrder.notes = value;
    this.validateField('notes');
  }

  /**
   * Update which fields are required based on current state
   */
  updateRequiredFields() {
    const workOrder = this.page.state.workOrder;
    const requiredFields = {
      description: true,  // Always required
      location: true,     // Always required
      priority: workOrder.emergency,  // Required if emergency
      notes: workOrder.emergency      // Required if emergency
    };
    
    this.page.state.requiredFields = requiredFields;
  }

  /**
   * Validate a specific field
   * @param {string} fieldId - The field to validate
   * @returns {boolean} - Whether the field is valid
   */
  validateField(fieldId) {
    const workOrder = this.page.state.workOrder;
    const requiredFields = this.page.state.requiredFields;
    const errors = this.page.state.validationErrors || {};
    
    // Clear previous error
    delete errors[fieldId];
    
    // Check if field is required and empty
    if (requiredFields[fieldId]) {
      switch (fieldId) {
        case 'description':
          if (!workOrder.description || workOrder.description.trim() === '') {
            errors[fieldId] = 'Description is required';
            return false;
          }
          break;
          
        case 'location':
          if (!workOrder.location || workOrder.location.trim() === '') {
            errors[fieldId] = 'Location is required';
            return false;
          }
          break;
          
        case 'priority':
          if (!workOrder.priority) {
            errors[fieldId] = 'Priority is required';
            return false;
          }
          break;
          
        case 'notes':
          if (workOrder.emergency && (!workOrder.notes || workOrder.notes.trim() === '')) {
            errors[fieldId] = 'Notes are required for emergency work orders';
            return false;
          }
          break;
      }
    }
    
    // Update validation errors
    this.page.state.validationErrors = errors;
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Validate the entire form
   * @returns {boolean} - Whether the form is valid
   */
  validateForm() {
    const fields = ['description', 'location', 'priority', 'notes'];
    let isValid = true;
    
    // Validate each field
    fields.forEach(field => {
      if (!this.validateField(field)) {
        isValid = false;
      }
    });
    
    return isValid;
  }

  /**
   * Handle form submission
   */
  handleSubmit() {
    if (this.validateForm()) {
      // Form is valid, proceed with submission
      this.app.toast('Work order submitted successfully', 'success');
      
      // In a real application, you would save the data here
      this.saveWorkOrder(this.page.state.workOrder);
    } else {
      // Show error message
      this.app.toast('Please correct the errors in the form', 'error');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Save work order to the server
   * @param {Object} workOrder - The work order data
   */
  async saveWorkOrder(workOrder) {
    try {
      // In a real application, this would be an API call
      console.log('Saving work order:', workOrder);
      
      // Simulate server call
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
      
      // Reset form after successful save
      this.page.state.workOrder = {};
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to save work order', error);
      this.app.toast('Failed to save work order', 'error');
    }
  }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
    <h2>{`Best Practices and Considerations`}</h2>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Validation Timing`}</strong>{`: Consider when to validate - on submit, on blur, or as the user types.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Error Messages`}</strong>{`: Provide specific, actionable error messages rather than generic ones.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Accessibility`}</strong>{`: Ensure error states are accessible to screen readers and other assistive technologies.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Conditional Requirements`}</strong>{`: Clearly indicate when fields become required based on other selections.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Performance`}</strong>{`: For large forms, consider validating fields individually rather than all at once.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Default Values`}</strong>{`: Provide sensible default values where appropriate to reduce the burden on users.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Error Recovery`}</strong>{`: Make it easy for users to correct errors without losing other entered data.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Mobile Considerations`}</strong>{`: Ensure validation works well on mobile devices with appropriate error placement.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Testing`}</strong>{`: Test required field validation with various input scenarios, including edge cases.`}</li>
    </ul>

    </MDXLayout>;
}
;
